sections.heading: What is trending: “witcher 3 remaster”
paragraphs: “witcher 3 remaster” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PL (snapshot taken 2026-08-25T21:44:18+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from CD PROJEKT RED Press Center, IGN, Nintendo Everything. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered Announced, Songs of the Past Gets First Look” — CD PROJEKT RED Press Center
“The Witcher 3 Remastered Launches September, as a Free Upgrade For All Owners” — IGN

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-25T21:44:18+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-25T21:45:11+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

This snapshot covers PL. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
